The **Food and Drug Administration (FDA)** is a federal agency of the United States Department of Health and Human Services. Its primary responsibility is to protect public health by ensuring the safety, efficacy, and security of:

- Human and veterinary drugs
- Biological products
- Medical devices
- Food supply
- Cosmetics
- Products that emit radiation

The FDA also plays a crucial role in regulating the manufacturing, marketing, and distribution of tobacco products and provides science-based health information to the public. Additionally, it contributes to counterterrorism efforts by ensuring food supply security and developing medical products to respond to public health threats.

For more detailed information, you can visit their official website: [U.S. Food and Drug Administration](https://www.fda.gov/).
